'''Gowix Corporation''' was a company headquartered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] around the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Firestorm" /> Founded before [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Gowix maintained [[Gowix Corp superstructure|offices]] on the edge of [[Archival Square]], a section of the [[Axial Park]] district in Corellia's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], and the company was caught up in the fighting when the Empire [[Battle of Corellia|invaded Corellia]]. The corporation's building in Axial Park was captured by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces, and the invaders set up a prototype weapon known as [[Firestorm Turbolaser]] in the company's offices with the intention of causing massive casualties in Archival Square. However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] infiltrated the building using an [[Imperial assault shuttle|assault shuttle]] and eliminated the Sith forces within the company's offices before destroying the weapon.<ref name="Firestorm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gowix Corporation first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Gowix's office tower is one of the buildings that Jedi Knight players are sent to during the class mission "Firestorm" on Corellia.<ref name="Firestorm" />
